long_biography.plain_text:
Wilbur and Lorene Hess founded Hess Oil Company after moving to Chickasha in 1946. Their son Jerry later led FACTOR, an enterprise-software division of W.R. Hess Company created for petroleum marketers. As president and chief executive, he oversaw products for accounting, convenience retail, wholesale distribution and fuel management. By 2018, FACTOR served 330 customers and more than 1,000 companies across North America.

PDI acquired FACTOR from W.R. Hess Company that year, extending the software platform into a larger petroleum-technology group. Hess continued his association with W.R. Hess in Oklahoma's petroleum-marketing sector. His career therefore spans two related operating systems: physical fuel marketing and software built for businesses that buy and resell refined petroleum products.
